title: Farewell, Year 13 – Class of 2026! 🎓
excerpt: Celebrating our Year 13 students as they wrap up their final year at Rosehill College. Wishing them all the best for the next chapter!
body:
And that is a wrap for our Year 13s of 2026! 🎓

Thank you for the memories, the laughs and all the good times along the way. As you head off to your next chapter, we wish you all the very best in whatever comes next.

Once a Rosehill student, always part of the whānau. 💚
